conflicts.fact: Whether moss has true stems and leaves (plant structure of bryophytes)
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2's Model Building phase defines the bryophyte category as 'no true roots, stem or leaves', while its Observe phase and Lesson 4's key (1a: no true roots, stems or leaves) refer to stem-like and leaf-like structures. Lesson 3 says moss 'has no true roots and no vascular tissue' and lists only rhizoids. Lessons are consistent on roots but Lesson 2 itself is inconsistent about stems/leaves; no contradiction on roots.

conflicts.fact: Which lessons the Lesson 1 model is revisited in
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says models are kept for revision in Lessons 4 and 8; Lesson 4 says models are collected for use in the Lesson 8 final model, but Lesson 4 revises the model 'from Lessons 1-3' and Lessons 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 also revise it. Lesson 7 says the model was 'started in Lesson 1 and revised in Lesson 4', ignoring Lessons 2 and 3.

conflicts.fact: Timing of the previous lesson's activity and which animal/plant phenomenon list is used
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 (teacher) says 'Yesterday your groups sorted these organisms in different ways' (Lesson 1 sorting was several lessons earlier), whereas Lesson 4 Predict says charts were made 'in earlier lessons'. Lesson 5 says 'seven animals' but its Predict phase lists eight (including tilapia or omena).

conflicts.fact: Number of animals in the set being classified
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 overview says 'seven animals' but lists earthworm, snail, grasshopper or butterfly, mosquito, tilapia/omena, lizard, chicken, goat (eight). Lesson 6 uses 7 animals (without tilapia) in its dichotomous key, though its Observed mentions fish.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson covers identifying unknown animals using dichotomous keys, and what Lesson 4 said it would do
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 ends asking whether the same method can identify animals (bridge to Lesson 5), but Lesson 5 does not use keys; Lesson 6 already has learners write and test an animal dichotomous key, while Lesson 7 says 'In Lesson 7 we will use dichotomous keys more carefully' and builds the animal key as if new. Lesson 7 Predict also says 'Last lesson, groups made different groupings', but Lesson 6 had a key challenge.
